SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ......
S.1, Special Branch [手写: 617]
REPORT    Date August 17, 1937.
Subject Gustor (Gustav) Otto Teppers - Communication dated August 12,
1937, from the Netherlands Consulate-General.
Made by D.S. Larby    Forwarded by C Crawford S S

With reference to the attached letter from the
Netherlands Consulate-General, requesting information regarding
one Gustor Otto Teppers, I have to state that Teppers formed
the subject of a similar communication dated September 12,
1931, from the Netherlands Consulate-General. The undermention-
ed details briefly summarize the activities of this individual :
Gustor (Gustav) Otto Teppers alias Ulrich Von
Lindeberg, alias Captain Nappy alias Captain Bergen, age 44,
has come to the notice of the Municipal Police on eight
occasions between May, 1925 and December, 1936, in connection
with charges of fraud, false pretences, larceny and possession
of firearms. In six instances, Teppers has been sentenced
to serve terms of imprisonment. Since 1931, however, Teppers
has only come to the notice of the Municipal Police on one
occasion namely the 12/12/36, when he was sentenced to 3
months' imprisonment on a charge of false pretences. Subsequent
to his release from Ward Road Gaol on the 12/3/37, the
activities of Teppers have not formed the subject of any
Police investigation.

[签名: D.S. Larby]
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch)
[手写批注: ok]

报告    日期 1937年8月17日。
事由 古斯托尔（古斯塔夫）·奥托·泰佩斯 - 荷兰总领事馆1937年8月12日来函。
撰写人 D.S. 拉比    转呈人 C. Crawford S S

参照附上的荷兰总领事馆来函，该函要求提供关于一名叫古斯托尔·奥托·泰佩斯者的信息，本人须说明，泰佩斯曾是荷兰总领事馆1931年9月12日类似来函的主题。以下细节简要总结了此人的活动：
古斯托尔（古斯塔夫）·奥托·泰佩斯，化名乌尔里希·冯·林德伯格（Ulrich Von Lindeberg），化名纳皮上尉（Captain Nappy），化名伯根上尉（Captain Bergen），年龄44岁，在1925年5月至1936年12月期间，因涉及欺诈、虚假借口、盗窃和持有枪支等指控，曾八次引起工部局警务处的注意。在其中六起案件中，泰佩斯被判处监禁。然而，自1931年以来，泰佩斯仅有一次引起工部局警务处的注意，即1936年12月12日，当时他因虚假借口罪被判处三个月监禁。继其于1937年3月12日从华德路监狱获释后，泰佩斯的活动未成为任何警方调查的主题。

[签名: D.S. Larby]
D. S.

特别处副处长

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 2629.                                          D 669
                     SHANGHAI, .    12th August 1937.

Sir,
     I have the honour to inform you that Gustor Otto Teppers
has applied to this Consulate for a visé for admission into
the Netherlands Indies.
     He is in possession of a Lithuanian passport No. 29877,
Serie OB No. 19057 issued by the Lithuanian Consulate at New
York on the 12th January 1937.
     According to his passport he is born at Memel in 1898.
     He states to be a coffee and sugar broker and intends to
visit the Netherlands Indies for about one or two months.
     His wife Eugenya Constantina Teppers will accompany him
on his trip.
     On March 22nd 1937 the local British Consulate-General
issued a visé valid for travelling to India and Burma.
     Teppers resides at 453 Boone Road.
     I should be much obliged to you if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known against this person from
                          or
a political moral point of view.

                                             I have the honour to be,
                                                        Sir,
                                             Your obedient servant,
           Sp B-
      (印：OFFICE OF ... 16 AUG. 1937 ...)       Acting Consul-General.

Major K. M. Bourne,
Deputy Commissioner i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

                                             D S. Carle,

                                               17/8

电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。

第 2629 号。                                          D 669
                     上海，1937年8月12日。

先生：
     谨此通知阁下，古斯托尔·奥托·泰佩斯已向本领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证。
     他持有一本立陶宛护照，号码为29877，OB系列第19057号，由立陶宛驻纽约领事馆于1937年1月12日签发。
     根据其护照，他于1898年出生在梅梅尔（Memel）。
     他自称是咖啡和糖经纪人，打算前往荷属东印度约一至两个月。
     他的妻子尤金妮亚·康斯坦丁娜·泰佩斯（Eugenya Constantina Teppers）将陪同他出行。
     1937年3月22日，当地英国总领事馆签发了前往印度和缅甸有效的签证。
     泰佩斯居住在布恩路453号。
     如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否知晓此人有任何不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

                                             顺致
                                                        崇高敬意，

Memorandum on a German named Gustav Otto Tonnara alias Ulrich Von Lindenburgh alias Frank Olaf Lund The above named first came to the notice of the Municipal Police on May 16, 1925 when he was arrested on a Mixed Court Warrant on a charge of obtaining merchandise valued at $1,120 from Chinese by means of fraud. After his release from prison in 1931 he left Shanghai
but returned in November, 1932. It is said that he spent
most of the time he was absent in Saigon and that he
succeeded in obtaining Ticals 10,000.00 by fraud there,
but this report has not been verified.

His description is as follows: Age 40; height
5'10"; medium build; fair complexion; grey eyes; blond
hair; bullet wound back of right hand. Speaks English
fluently and represents himself as an engineer by
profession.

He is at present residing with his wife at No.10
Park Lane. The latter is said to be an ex-prostitute
whose maiden name was E. Belshavn.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

1931年出狱后，他离开上海，但于1932年11月返回。据说他在缺席期间大部分时间待在西贡，并在那里成功诈骗了10,000.00泰铢，但此报告未经核实。

其体貌特征如下：年龄40岁；身高5英尺10英寸；中等身材；肤色白皙；灰眼睛；金发；右手背部有枪伤。英语流利，自称职业为工程师。

他目前与妻子居住在派克弄10号。据说其妻曾是妓女，婚前姓名为E.贝尔沙文（E. Belshavn）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
U. S. S. R. REGISTRY
N. D 669
D: 5 / 7 / 33

July 1st 33

Dear Carlsen,

I have a suspicion that the German named
Lund who pretends to be able to furnish particulars
about the Singapore base is identical with an
imposter of the same name and nationality who is
well known to the Police.

I am sending you a photograph of the latter
and shall be thankful if you could kindly find out
if my suspicion is well founded.

Yours sincerely,

Lieut. E. Carlsen,
Intelligence Office,
U.S.Marine Corps.

（批：Believed to be Von
Lindenberg. file
D 669.）
